name: Sports & Fitness
description: Running, swimming, calisthenics, and the occasional half marathon
extendedDescription:
Beyond badminton, I try to stay active across a range of sports. I run, swim, and do calisthenics regularly — not obsessively, but consistently enough that it's become part of the routine. The occasional half marathon gets thrown in when I feel like a structured target.

I like the variety. Different sports train different things, and mixing them up keeps motivation high and reduces the risk of burning out on any one discipline. There's also something satisfying about getting fitter in ways that directly improve your court speed and endurance.
